notes: scan052.N1: This is a handwritten mathematical text sheet. The whole page was viewed once for layout, then both native halves once; every running line, display, diagram and revision layer was read against both supplied witnesses. No dark authorial page number is visible at the head.

scan052.N2: Conditions c) and d) of (21) state a cover and an intersection expressed as a union over common lower indices. Their role in assuring (20) was carried as mathematical background only. The first factor in I times I is visually retraced and is retained as unsure{I|X}; the formula was not regularised from its expected domain.

scan052.N3: The proposition asserts that the displayed canonical map from the indicated Lim construction to X is a homeomorphism. Capital Lim, its right arrow below, the underbrace, main arrow with tilde, lower curly enclosure, and two then three individually headed left arrows were all read. The first reader did not prove the assertion; the later main-reader targeted proof is recorded in scan052.N13.

scan052.N4: The variants paragraph names arbitrary flags and nondegenerate flags, and the corollary starts from an ordered topological space. This mathematics was carried only as background. In particular it did not supply the missing opening parenthesis in the first reference, remove the doubtful point after les, or reconstruct cancelled corollary words.

scan052.N5: The literal punctuation differs from both witnesses in the absent heading stops after Proposition and Corollaire and the visible colon after Soit. The first reference is 1') with no opening parenthesis. The point after les remains explicitly doubtful because a speck cannot be excluded. H's bold heading wrappers versus C's underlining are treated as typography, not as additional textual corrections; the actual underlines are preserved.

scan052.N6: The lower layer order is represented as old supposons plus the cancelled X_Delta1 clause; then the raised et soit family/partition replacement; then the second lower-left cancelled supposons and the small cancelled fragment; then the live final X_Delta0 line. Within the raised replacement, the blackened old subscript and the cancelled famille have separate local inventory entries. The final i replaces the blackened old subscript. The relative timing of the two lower-left cancellations cannot be reconstructed from the ink.

scan052.N7: Cancelled pouvoir en déduire, the tiny e, est une partie fermée, famille and the second supposons remain doubtful. The newly preserved old subscript and small lower fragment also remain doubtful. The visible first old X_Delta1 can be read securely without its former whole-formula doubt. H's prose note about a following page is editorial, is not copied into this transcription, and was not used to supply readings.

scan052.N8: The pale lower-left 51 is another hand's foliation. C's numeral is correct; changing mspage to margin records provenance only and is not a substantive C disagreement. H's omission of the written folio is a substantive omission.

scan052.N9: The sole supplied mark M0981 is settled to its first reading i from the separate dot and short shaft after the blackened old subscript. The newly described older subscript remains unsure{Delta_0|Delta}. Certainty changes alone are excluded from disagreement counts.

scan052.N10. First-pass accounting, retained as history; the final reconciled totals are in the changes summary and this report’s counts object. There are 48 substantive local change rows, each tied to a physical place. Diff-C flags total 6: 3 secure and 3 explicitly tentative. Diff-H flags total 48: 40 secure and 8 explicitly tentative. These include all tentative recoveries/omissions and exclude macro syntax, the new I-versus-X certainty qualification and certainty-only mark resolutions. Unique-row error-category counts are {1: 3, 2: 3, 3: 19, 4: 2, 5: 10, 6: 1, 7: 3, 9: 4, 10: 3}.

scan052.N11: Twenty crops were generated and each usable crop was viewed once. The attempted first delivery of r10 was truncated by the tool context and supplied no usable image; its successful subsequent delivery was the reading view. r19 is a supplementary close strip whose upper edge clips ascenders on the rising right-hand end of the final line; it is not used as a sole audit box. The complete lower block and entire final line are visible in r15, used for their audit. No additional crop or rereading of a decided place was performed.

scan052.N12: The difference table's layout tokens for aligned/cases, row spacing, substack and TikZ arguments are distinguished from ink differences. The two-arrow group is the same in both encodings; the three separately headed arrows are represented explicitly. No OCR, external research, other-page reading, or TeX compilation was used.

scan052.N13: Main-reader targeted check of the proposition, using the locally finite closed family of (1′) on scan045 and conditions (21)c,d here. The map q from the disjoint union of the X_i to X is surjective by c). For a closed subset of that disjoint union, its intersections with the summands are closed in X_i, hence closed in X; their locally finite union is closed. Thus q is a closed quotient map. If two summand points represent the same x in X, d) supplies k below both indices with x in X_k; the two inclusion arrows connect them through that summand. Conversely every arrow preserves x. The equivalence relation generated by the two face maps is therefore precisely the kernel relation of q, so its topological coequalizer is X. Higher flag degrees add no further identifications. Nondegenerate flags still supply all nonidentity comparable arrows, so the same quotient conclusion holds. This checks the canonical-map assertion in that interpretation; formula (20) is on a missing scan and was not reconstructed.

scan052.N14. Blind adjudication adds a doubtful cancelled que before the old X_Delta1 from its loop, descending shaft and low continuation under the raised soit. It qualifies on a in (21)d, the colon/semicolon after formelle, and cancelled simplexes/simplices; famille now explicitly admits the short part alternative. The visible lower revision layers are preserved without inventing a strict temporal order. The final family i is already inside the insertion, and the tiny lower looped fragment is retained as doubtful cancelled où rather than replaced wholesale by an arrow. This qualifies the first-pass certainty and count statements; original first and independent readings remain unchanged.
